title: 混合整数目标规划实现个性化膳食优化
summary: 提出混合整数目标规划（MIGP）用于个性化膳食优化，采用整数变量实现实际份数，目标规划偏差处理软营养目标，逆目标归一化平衡多营养优化。在810个实例中，MIGP在66%情况下优于后取整方法，求解时间低于100毫秒，开源Python模块已集成到交互式应用中。
summary_en: Proposes Mixed Integer Goal Programming (MIGP) for personalized meal optimization, using integer variables for practical servings and goal programming deviations for soft nutrient targets. Outperforms rounding in 66% of 810 instances, solve times under 100ms, open-source Python module integrated into an interactive app.
